A1.justification: Both complete 34-page PDFs describe the same Qualcomm Interactive Cooking and LiveMamba research. Text and rendered pages support reliable comparison, including all appendices and the checklist. Differences are confined to the revision stamp and a resource-access footnote.

before.justification: v1 reports original zero-shot, fine-tuned, and turn-based evaluations in Tables 3–5, including ablations, plus qualitative LiveMamba predictions in Appendix E and Figure 7.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Tables 3–5 and the qualitative predictions in Appendix E and Figure 7.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Appendices C–D retain the same InternViT/Q-Former/Mamba architecture, response mechanism, re-planner, training procedure, and augmentation components.

E1.justification: Both retain the main and advanced planning sets of Qualcomm Interactive Cooking, streaming and turn-based evaluation, and the same LVIS, EPIC-KITCHENS, Ego4D, and SSv2 training coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in each corresponding experiment: the zero-shot models in Table 3, fine-tuned VideoLLM-online in Table 4, and VideoLLaMA3/Qwen baselines in Table 5.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, metrics, training settings, and testing procedures are unchanged. Both specify the same 30-second evaluation window, five-second prompting interval, and training/inference settings in Appendix D.3.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the same instruction-completion augmentation, counterfactual augmentation, and re-planning ablations. The qualitative examples and analyses in Figures 3–7 and Appendix E are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports different run counts, seeds, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests. Both retain point estimates and the same checklist statement about computationally prohibitive statistical analysis and initially observed limited variance.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are identical. For example, Table 4 retains LiveMamba's main-set IC-Acc of 31.5 and mistake F1 of 0.13, while Table 5 retains its turn-based IC-Acc of 51.0. Appendix statistics and predictions also match.

T1.justification: The evaluation definitions in Section 5.1 are unchanged. Neither version adds or removes mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about the new cooking benchmark, LiveMamba's streaming guidance capabilities, and its performance relative to existing models.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of augmentation and re-planning benefits, the limitations of offline non-reactive evaluation, and qualifications about cooking-domain scope, subtle mistakes, and advanced planning difficulty.

D1.justification: The page-2 footnote changes from separate direct links to the Hugging Face dataset and GitHub evaluation repository to one Project Page link. The dataset URL remains in the checklist, and implementation details are unchanged. This revises access instructions; the PDFs do not establish any change in resource availability.

R1.justification: Section 2, the references, and the positioning against procedural-activity datasets and streaming video models are identical. The project-page link does not introduce a new cited research work.

P1.justification: The resource footnote is shortened from separate data/code access wording to Project Page, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. All other prose, section organization, and appendix structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–7 retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. Page layout is unchanged; the revision-stamp and footnote wording edits do not reorganize the displays.

improvement.justification: The methods, claims, experimental evidence, limitations, and complete appendices are identical. Replacing separate resource links with a project-page link is a small navigation edit, with no documented new resources or resolved reproducibility deficiency. Together with the updated revision stamp, it leaves the paper's overall quality effectively unchanged.
